correctness.rationale: Using the four actual length-21 generator rows of Kawamoto–Kato–Maruta Example 2.1 and alpha^2=alpha+1, a fresh independent GF(4) implementation enumerated all 85 nonzero projective points and 85 planes, without sampling. Hyperplane multiplicities exactly reproduce the printed 1..10 spectrum (2,4,12,12,22,16,6,4,3,4). For n=21,q=4,w=3 the sole exceptional plane residue is 0 mod4: 12 four-planes and 4 eight-planes. Counting every incidence yields (N0,...,N7)=(2,1,16,9,25,23,2,7). Unique depth-one point is (0,0,1,3), with zero generator multiplicity; depth two occurs 16 times. Incidence checksum is 336=16*21. This complete finite enumeration proves the finite claim subject to faithful transcription of the printed matrix, which was directly inspected in the primary rendered article.
residual_risks: The histogram is for the specific printed code, not all [21,4,11] codes or arbitrary monomial equivalents without carrying forward the identifying geometry.
